title: Ironhand
summary: Ironhand is a spell that coats the caster's hand in a metallic casing that can be used for protection or to amplify a punch. When manifested, this spell emits a yellow aura.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This spell was used by [[Guggenheim]] in [[Hamelin Cathedral]], along with [[Spidertouch]], to collapse one of the cathedral's wooden beams onto a mischief of the rat-like [[Gremlow]] Titans. {{source|Gremlow Infestation!}}

'''Ironhand''' is a spell that coats the caster's hand in a metallic casing that can be used for protection or to amplify a punch. When manifested, this spell emits a yellow aura.

== History ==
This spell was used by [[Guggenheim]] in [[Hamelin Cathedral]], along with [[Spidertouch]], to collapse one of the cathedral's wooden beams onto a mischief of the rat-like [[Gremlow]] Titans. {{source|Gremlow Infestation!}}
